notes.title: Pump, Flip and Fire Pack DLC | Patch 8.2 | Out Now!
notes.content: [p]Pump, flip, unfold, and fire with 3 curated tactile hunting weapons: a modern lever-action rifle, a fast-loading pump-action rifle, and a lightweight portable folding shotgun. Available now![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="E08BjCScFv0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Pump, Flip and Fire Weapon Pack[/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3750770/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Pump_Flip_and_Fire_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Anantha Action .22 MAG[/h2][list][*][p]Lightweight and sturdy lever-action rifle.[/p][/*][*][p]Smooth action, low recoil.[/p][/*][*][p]Recommended for small game (Animal Class: 1-2).[/p][/*][*][p]New ammo: hollow point and jacketed hollow point .22 Magnum.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/bad43cfb52942988d1f4c4075b55d064c5c66967.png"][/img][/p][h2]Frost .257[/h2][list][*][p]Classic magazine-fed pump-action rifle.[/p][/*][*][p]Versatile and powerful.[/p][/*][*][p]Recommended for multiple animal classes (2-6).[/p][/*][*][p]New ammo: soft point and polymer tip .257 Roberts ammo.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/7afc373908c4f613d4dec5b524ad27a6c72b1478.png"][/img][/p][h2]Giddings SSC .410 Coyote[/h2][list][*][p]Ultra-lightweight and single-shot folding shotgun.[/p][/*][*][p]Folds for easy backpack storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Ideal for close range and quick shots (Animal Class: 1-5).[/p][/*][*][p]It can be used with .410 birdshot ammo and all new .410 buckshot and slug ammo too.[/p][/*][/list][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/1fd0cb44be7943d5591c3e465d959c87e303eb63.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Patch 8.2[/h1][h2]Highlights[/h2][p]We've completely overhauled the initial hunts on Hirschfelden, Layton Lake District, and Medved-Taiga to be more intuitive for new players. Easier first harvests are now within reach with helpful point-of-interest icons and highlighted organs. [/p][p][/p][p]Plus, keep an eye out for two stunning new Gray Wolf variations (Melanistic Charcoal and Acromelanistic) and a visual upgrade to the lying-down Gray Wolf trophy! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/dcb638d4571028577fbfb2dcb6c416dd85d385ae.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also remastered the Mule Deer TruRacs, adding a variety of new antler variations, and fixed some bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]Full Patch Notes:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/518790/view/511841259183145356?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Happy hunting![/p]

tags.feature: We've completely overhauled the initial hunts on Hirschfelden, Layton Lake District, and Medved-Taiga to be more intuitive for new players. Easier first harvests are now within reach with helpful point-of-interest icons and highlighted organs.
Plus, keep an eye out for two stunning new Gray Wolf variations (Melanistic Charcoal and Acromelanistic) and a visual upgrade to the lying-down Gray Wolf trophy!
We've also remastered the Mule Deer TruRacs, adding a variety of new antler variations, and fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Patch 8.2 Notes
notes.content: [h1]Pump, Flip and Fire Pack DLC[/h1][p]This weapon pack features three new tactile firearms that bring a fresh level of versatility to your hunts.[/p][list][*][p]Anantha Action .22 MAG - lightweight but sturdy lever-action rifle.[/p][/*][*][p]Frost .257 - a classic magazine-fed pump-action rifle.[/p][/*][*][p]Giddings SSC .410 Coyote - an ultra lightweight single-shot folding shotgun.[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="XZsRiKt3n3U;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Patch 8.2[/h1][p]We'll be transitioning to a numbered system (8.2, 8.3, and so on) for future releases. These release numbers won't directly match the build numbers you see in-game.[/p][p]We hope this change will make it easier to discuss and keep track of which patch was when in the future.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p][b]First Hunt Overhaul[/b][/p][p]New players will find their initial hunts on Hirschfelden, Layton Lake District, and Medved-Taiga to be more intuitive than ever. We've added a helpful point of interest icon and highlighted organs when aiming, making those first harvests easier to achieve.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rare Gray Wolf Variations[/b][/p][p]Keep your eyes peeled for two brand new Gray Wolf fur variations: Melanistic Charcoal and Acromelanistic.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/36d5a3a094aa625cfb881ad747385c904358620c.png"][/img][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]We've given the Gray Wolf trophy a visual upgrade when displayed lying down. [/p][/*][*][p]We've addressed issues with the Bighorn Sheep skeletal model in the X-ray view and smoothed out its running animation.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mule Deer TruRacs have been remastered. We also added multiple new antler variations for this species.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the trophy rating for the Male Springbok was capped..[/p][/*][*][p]North American Beaver’s droppings will now be displayed correctly as droppings and not tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]Animals will now appear at the correct distance on the harvest screen when shot while running.[/p][/*][*][p]Beaver mating calls will display visual waves and trigger interactions when the animal is in the water.[/p][/*][*][p]Pheasant hens will no longer have a line on their wings in the harvest screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Beavers’ skinning on the tail has been improved, and liver shots will display correctly in the X-ray model.[/p][/*][*][p]Black Bear paw bones will no longer appear separated in the X-ray view.[/p][/*][*][p]Mountain Goat horns are now properly attached to the skull in the X-ray view.[/p][/*][*][p]Wood Duck neck bones will now have names when viewed in the Harvest screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The Water Buffalo's rear leg will no longer appear detached from the pelvis in the X-ray view.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed a visual issue with the fleeing Manitoban Elk.[/p][/*][*][p]Northern Pintail wing bones will no longer clip through feathers on the harvest screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dismantling deployables in multiplayer will now play the correct sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Snow Geese will now honk while flying high.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Equipment[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Fors Elite .300 rifle will no longer exhibit animation bugs when rechambering while crouching.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a clipping issue when rechambering and reloading a Zagan Varminter .22-250.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a clipping issue when chambering the Fors Elite 300 with a scope equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ranger .243 is now accurate at all distances when using iron sights or TruVision.[/p][/*][*][p]Crouching before preparing a shot will no longer prevent hip-fire shots with some lever-action and pump-action weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]The 7MM Regent Magnum's point of aim is now correctly aligned at medium range when used without a scope.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where lever-action rifle animations could desynchronize during reloads while aiming.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Missions[/b][/p][list][*][p]The "Low Land" mission will no longer be blocked if player has visited the landmarks beforehand.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue where the "Albertan Apex" side mission could be completed without meeting all mission requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]Taking a picture of the carcass during the "Aftermath" mission is now easier to register.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Multiplayer[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause the game to temporarily freeze if the network connection was interrupted while trying to join a multiplayer game on Xbox.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where non-high flying waterfowl would briefly freeze for players when the session host moved a significant distance away.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Trophies[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Mule Deer's final pose will no longer clip through walls in trophy lodges.[/p][/*][*][p]The fur variation for the Melanistic Pronghorn is now correctly displayed on trophies.[/p][/*][*][p]The Female Manitoban Elk head trophy will no longer have stretched textures clipping below the plaque.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with Wood Duck Female trophies.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where voice-overs and subtitles were mismatched.[/p][/*][*][p]The Tundra Bean Goose now has an image on the HUD when spotted.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]World[/b][/p][list][*][p]Snow deformation will no longer cover blood tracks.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: New players will find their initial hunts on Hirschfelden, Layton Lake District, and Medved-Taiga to be more intuitive than ever. We've added a helpful point of interest icon and highlighted organs when aiming, making those first harvests easier to achieve.
Keep your eyes peeled for two brand new Gray Wolf fur variations: Melanistic Charcoal and Acromelanistic.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the trophy rating for the Male Springbok was capped..
North American Beaver’s droppings will now be displayed correctly as droppings and not tracks.
Animals will now appear at the correct distance on the harvest screen when shot while running.
Beaver mating calls will display visual waves and trigger interactions when the animal is in the water.
Pheasant hens will no longer have a line on their wings in the harvest screen.
Beavers’ skinning on the tail has been improved, and liver shots will display correctly in the X-ray model.
Black Bear paw bones will no longer appear separated in the X-ray view.
Mountain Goat horns are now properly attached to the skull in the X-ray view.
Wood Duck neck bones will now have names when viewed in the Harvest screen.
The Water Buffalo's rear leg will no longer appear detached from the pelvis in the X-ray view.
We’ve fixed a visual issue with the fleeing Manitoban Elk.
Northern Pintail wing bones will no longer clip through feathers on the harvest screen.
Dismantling deployables in multiplayer will now play the correct sound.
Snow Geese will now honk while flying high.
The Fors Elite .300 rifle will no longer exhibit animation bugs when rechambering while crouching.
Fixed a clipping issue when rechambering and reloading a Zagan Varminter .22-250.
Fixed a clipping issue when chambering the Fors Elite 300 with a scope equipped.

tags.balance_change: The Ranger .243 is now accurate at all distances when using iron sights or TruVision.

tags.bug: Crouching before preparing a shot will no longer prevent hip-fire shots with some lever-action and pump-action weapons.

tags.balance_change: The 7MM Regent Magnum's point of aim is now correctly aligned at medium range when used without a scope.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where lever-action rifle animations could desynchronize during reloads while aiming.
The "Low Land" mission will no longer be blocked if player has visited the landmarks beforehand.
We’ve fixed an issue where the "Albertan Apex" side mission could be completed without meeting all mission requirements.
Taking a picture of the carcass during the "Aftermath" mission is now easier to register.
Fixed an issue that could cause the game to temporarily freeze if the network connection was interrupted while trying to join a multiplayer game on Xbox.
Fixed an issue where non-high flying waterfowl would briefly freeze for players when the session host moved a significant distance away.
The Mule Deer's final pose will no longer clip through walls in trophy lodges.
The fur variation for the Melanistic Pronghorn is now correctly displayed on trophies.
The Female Manitoban Elk head trophy will no longer have stretched textures clipping below the plaque.
Fixed a bug with Wood Duck Female trophies.
Fixed an issue where voice-overs and subtitles were mismatched.
The Tundra Bean Goose now has an image on the HUD when spotted.
Snow deformation will no longer cover blood tracks.

notes.title: Snowfall Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Alberta Hunting Preserve
[/h1][p]On June 17th, Askiy Ridge Hunting Preserve will open its doors to hunters. Snowy and frigid landscape, [url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/hVSMoZxCTXk"][u]19 animal species[/u][/url] including North American Beaver and Manitoban Elk, 13 unique missions, and more await the brave in Alberta, Canada.
[/p][h2]Paid Content Highlights
[/h2][list][*][p]19 animals to hunt: Whitetail Deer, Black Bear, Moose, Canada Goose, Mallard, Mule Deer, Gray Wolf, Bighorn Sheep, Mountain Goat, Pronghorn, Ring-Necked Pheasant, Dusky Grouse (NEW), North American Beaver (NEW), Wood Bison (NEW), Manitoban Elk (NEW), Woodland Caribou (NEW), Northern Pintail (NEW), Wood Duck (NEW), Snow Goose (NEW).[/p][/*][*][p]New callers for: Northern Pintail, Snow Goose, and Wood Duck.[/p][/*][*][p]New lever-action rifle, the Laperriere Outrider .30-30.[/p][/*][*][p]A new reserve questline.[/p][/*][*][p]New feature: Deep Snow. The snow in Askiy Ridge is deep and compacts as players and animals move through it. Note that this graphical feature is optionally available on PC (Settings -> Visual -> Snow Deformation), and is enabled by default for players on Xbox Series and PlayStation 5 consoles. This feature is not available on Xbox One and PlayStation 4.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570290/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Alberta_Hunting_Preserve/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Snowfall Update[/h1][p][/p][p]Check out a plethora of improvements and fixes in the free Snowfall Update, releasing alongside Alberta Hunting Preserve.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Content and Improvements[/h2][p][/p][p][b]New Great One[/b][/p][p]The Great One Mule Deer is available to hunt![/p][p]Mule Deer populations in Parque Fernando, Rancho del Arroyo and Silver Ridge Peaks got reset.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/c73b42b9d73f2202a74df811043253e678d65247.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Snowy Animals[/b][/p][p]In snowy climates, snow will now accumulate on animals.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Multimounts[/b][/p][p]Two new multimounts have been added, one for our new North American Beaver and another for Mule Deer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Outfit[/b][/p][p]Buffalo Plaid Utility Outfit, themed after the snowy wilds of Alberta, is available for purchase![/p][p][/p][p][b]New World Map[/b][/p][p]The world map has been completely redesigned to accommodate more locations in the future.
[/p][p][b]DLC Library Bar (Beta)[/b][/p][p]Some players will see a new bar on the main menu, which displays currently owned and available DLC packs. This bar is currently in testing and will only be available to a limited group of players.[/p][p][/p][h3]Animal Improvements[/h3][p][/p][p]Bighorn Sheep: [/p][list][*][p]Their models have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]New fur variations were added, and all existing fur variations were redone.[/p][/*][*][p]All TruRACs horns have been replaced with new, more realistic models. Scoring ranges have been revised based on the new models. The old models will still be present on trophies acquired before this patch.[/p][/*][*][p]New audio for calls was added.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Pronghorn[/p][list][*][p]Their models have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]New fur variations were added, and all existing fur variations were redone.[/p][/*][*][p]All TruRACs horns have been replaced with new, more realistic models. Scoring ranges have been revised based on the new models. The old models will still be present on Trophies acquired before this patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Some new animations were added[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Mountain Goat[/p][list][*][p]Their models have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]Existing Fur variations have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain animations have been redone to match the new models.[/p][/*][*][p]New audio for calls has been added.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Canada Goose[/p][list][*][p]Their models have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]New plumage was added, and all existing plumage variations were redone.[/p][/*][*][p]The rarities of certain existing plumages have been rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some animation improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Gray Wolf[/p][list][*][p]Their models have been redone.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New fur variations were added, and all existing fur variations were redone.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new and improved calls.[/p][/*][*][p]Extensive fixes and improvements to wolf animations and behaviors.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Grant Caribou (renamed to differentiate from the new Woodland Caribou)[/p][list][*][p]Their models have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve recreated all previously existing fur variations[/p][/*][*][p]Added some animation improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Mule Deer[/p][list][*][p]Their models have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]New fur variations were added, and all existing fur variations were redone.[/p][/*][/list][p]Reindeer renamed to “Mountain Reindeer” for more clarity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tutorials[/b][/p][p]We’ve made multiple improvements to our existing tutorial pop-ups, including:[/p][list][*][p]Enhanced their look and feel.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve made it easier to dismiss tutorials.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to change the keybind for dismissing tutorials.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Equipment[/b][/p][list][*][p].30-30 ammunition has been retuned to improve muzzle velocity and reduce wind resistance.[/p][/*][*][p]The existing elk caller will now also work for the new Manitoban Elk.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]An issue where the front legs of various deer species would move awkwardly when executing various animations was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve addressed an animation issue when the Mule Deer are grooming themselves.[/p][/*][*][p]The Himilayan Tahr on Te Awaroa and Blacktail Deer on Layton Lake will now correctly make audible calls.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue with the Tibetan Fox warning calls.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue with the idle animation on various deer got fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The tibiae of various ground birds will now be labelled correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed several visual issues with Black Bear paws.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve addressed several issues and added some significant improvements to Black Bear animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Animals will no longer rotate unnaturally when they stop moving.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue where the antlers of various deer species could be slightly out of sync when the animal was in motion was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve adjusted the alignment of Moose spines.[/p][/*][*][p]Neck bone issues on Mallards got resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue with animal ragdolls that could make animals move awkwardly after being shot while idle.[/p][/*][*][p]Black Bears will now perform their mating calls as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve made improvements to animal pathing around water to reduce rare cases of animals running through water.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue that could cause high-flying geese to behave erratically was addressed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed a problem with the claws on Iberian Wolves.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve improved the transition and flow of Whitetail Deer jumping animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Animals will no longer rapidly gain speed after changing running direction.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve addressed an issue with animation that could happen with aggravated Capercaillies.[/p][/*][*][p]Various issues with Grouse animations were fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve adjusted the level of shininess on Blackbucks' fur.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve optimized some insect noises on Vurhonga Savanna to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue where the sound for building a hunting structure didn't trigger properly on several reserves.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Customization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removing a scope from a customized rifle using the Storage Cache, will now correctly keep its custom look until you attach another scope.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Dogs[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve fixed a number of locations in Revontuli Coast where dogs couldn't find good spots to wait outside for the player.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve addressed several issues with dog behavior around various locations in New England Mountains and Emerald Coast.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Equipment[/b][/p][list][*][p].45 Colt Flat Nose Hard-Cast and .45 Colt Full Metal Jacket ammo is no longer marked as rifle ammo for Mangiafico 410/45 handgun.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue that forced lever-action rifles to fully reload if the rechamber animation was interrupted by looking at an invalid target.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue with the alignment of the model on the ZARZA-15 .223 and ZARZA-10 .308 rifles was addressed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve improved the animations for the bolt travelling when firing the Solokhin MN1890 rifles.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed visual issues with the Grelck Drilling Rifle that only appeared when seen on other players.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected M1 animation issues while moving and hip-firing.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue causing rain sounds inside tents during snow.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual issues that occurred when reloading the Hudzik rifles were fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve addressed an issue where it was possible to start aiming with the Strandberg 10SA before it had finished the reload animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Strecker SXS 20G is now more accurate with slugs and the Reflex Sight.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several animation errors on weapons that use .308 ammunition.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed minor accuracy issues with several weapons: Solokhin, Zagan, 7mm Magnum, Cuoso, Kullman, Zarza 10, and Martensson 6.5mm.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]The tracking distance displayed on the Harvest Screen will no longer be incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Rapid follow-up shots now consistently hit animals reacting to a previous shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Wolves will no longer occasionally get into Ground Blinds to attack the player.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue where players weren't able to load into a reserve at the tent closest to their last position.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Graphics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the quality of some shadows, particularly on smaller objects.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Multiplayer[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue where another player's ATV would float around if they fast-traveled away while riding it.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve corrected a bug that occurred when a server host tried to harvest an animal that another player was already harvesting, causing multiple issues for both parties.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue where the clay shooter in Salzwiesen Park could stop working if players tried to activate it at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]A crash that could happen if the player disconnects while setting up a new Multiplayer game was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve made the error message that occurs when disconnecting while trying to join a multiplayer session on Xbox more clear.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed a rare issue where players might see an unclear error message if they were disconnected from the internet while trying to join a multiplayer game on Xbox.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve optimized several texture assets to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue that could occasionally cause the game to crash during gameplay on Xbox.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed an issue where respawning at an outpost after being knocked out could cause the camera to clip through the terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Keybind changes will now be saved correctly after the first time if the player tried to change keybinds multiple times during the same session.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue where the game could soft-lock after attempting to load backup save data on PlayStation was solved.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash if players switched profiles while loading the game on Xbox.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve addressed a crash that could occasionally happen when disconnecting a controller on Xbox.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed a small memory leak that could occur when checking for input devices on Xbox.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue that could cause the game to freeze if the user switched profiles while the game was suspended on Xbox was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Signing out of an Xbox profile in a Trophy Lodge no longer causes a crash.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Trophies[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Gandhare Rifle will now fit properly on the trophy stands in Saseka Safari Trophy Lodge.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue with the David vs Goliath multimount.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue where multiple game invites from the same person would persist in the Apex UI.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve adjusted the outfit preview pictures to remove white outlines.[/p][/*][*][p]Rangemaster 338 Championship Rifle will now display correct statistics.[/p][/*][*][p]The tooltip for Green Wing Teal Decoys on the world map is now correct.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve optimized HUD rendering to improve performance.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]World[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue with some water in the Tichenau region of Hirschfelden.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve cut down some errant grass growing in an odd place near the Brindleton Pit Stop Outpost on Emerald Coast.[/p][/*][*][p]Animals in Emerald Coast and Sundarpatan now drink closer to the visible water again.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed some object clipping issues in various locations around Emerald Coast.[/p][/*][*][p]Various collision and item placement issues around Sunderpatan were fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed a visual issue with the stairs outside of the Pauwa Outpost on Sundarpatan.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can no longer get stuck in the haystacks outside the Sheetal Gaun outpost on Sundarpatan.[/p][/*][*][p]Water Layout Blind placement should work properly again in Revontuli Coast.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve grounded a floating tree outside Retz Notch Hut in New England Mountains.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed some collision issues with several lookout towers on Te Awaroa.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve addressed some collision issues in various locations around Silver Ridge Peaks.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Known Issues[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]If a player with an active Zeroing Perk presses the "Use Skill" button while holding a non-weapon item, the Zeroing will reset to default (mid-range) when they switch back to a weapon. notes.title: Rapid Hunt Rifle Pack – Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Add three new semi-autos to your hunting collection[/h2]
The Rapid Hunt Rifle Pack is out now and includes three tough-built and reliable semi-automatic rifles aptly named for their rapid firing power.

[previewyoutube=EoCemJZZmVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]PERRY .308[/h3]
With powerful recoil management and gas-operated long-stroke piston action, every shot will feel just as effective as the last. 

The PERRY has .308 ammunition and is built for medium to big game hunting, covering classes 4-8.

[h3]HANSSON .30-06[/h3]
Designed for quick action and hip fire and built with great attention to detail, you’ll get extremely smooth action, allowing you to land fast follow-up shots. 

The HANSSON has .30-06 ammunition and is another great fit for medium to big game, also covering classes 4-8.

[h3]QUIST REAPER 7.62X39[/h3]
With the force of 7.62x39mm rounds and the precision hunters crave, this is a timeless choice. It’s easy to use and rocks a brand new ammo type. 

The QUIST REAPER is great for small to medium game, covering classes 2-6.

You can find the Rapid Hunt Rifle Pack across all platforms for $4.99

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447720/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Rapid_Hunt_Rifle_Pack/

[h2]March Update[/h2]
In addition to the new Rifle Pack, today you’ll also get a new patch with bug fixes. Check out the full [url=https://callofthewild.thehunter.com/patch-notes-march25/]Patch Notes [/url]for more details.

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
Looking for Tahr? You’ll start to see them out on [url=https://callofthewild.thehunter.com/home/dlc/reserves/thehunter-call-of-the-wild-te-awaroa-national-park/]Te Awaroa[/url]! With that, the Chamois will also get a population reset.

[h2]Community Challenges[/h2]
You might notice something new on your menu screen. The first Community Challenge starts in 2 days and offers exclusive cosmetics for everyone who participates. 

We’ll have to work together to unlock the rewards, so prepare by making sure you’re geared up for medium-sized game.

[h2]Livestream[/h2]
Don’t forget that we’re hosting a launch stream with Vivi and Tommy at 16:30 CET, 8:30AM PST on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/expansiveworlds]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ExpansiveWorlds]YouTube[/url]. We’ll be focusing on the new weapon pack from the perspective of a lead animator. We hope to see you there!

notes.title: The Winter Hotfix is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters!

A new hotfix has been released to resolve some of the bugs that have arisen since the launch of the Winter Update. Let's take a look at the details!

[h2]Developer’s Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some players have been having problems with their game progress not being saved. If your game is on a PC, sometimes, Windows Security might stop you from reaching the Documents folder (that's where your save files are). So you need to allow (or whitelist) your apps to access it. Plus, using Norton Anti-Virus may wrongly block parts of your save data thinking they are harmful. So, try to check your computer's security settings to make sure they are not stopping the game from saving your progress. For more help, visit our support page.
[*] It's been pointed out by a few players that a picture of Florian Jansen, who is the key contact for Salzwiesen Park, can't be found in the Codex. This is done on purpose. Florian values his privacy, and didn’t want his picture publicly available.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]EQUIPMENT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Decoys and callers associated with birds found in Salzwiesen Park which can also be found in other locations should now be available if the player only purchases Salzwiesen Park.
[/list]
[h3]ANIMALS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upland birds such as Pheasants and Grouses should be more reactive to the threatening presence of players and dogs. They should also be better at trying to fly away when there’s no nearby available cover.
[*] Waterfowl should be less wary again, and land more frequently.
[/list]
[h3]DOG[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Flush” command should now always display on the dog wheel when it is available for use.
[*] Birds should be less wary of being pointed at by the dog.
[/list]
[h3]TROPHIES[/h3]
[list]
[*] When replacing existing trophies in a Trophy Lodge, the swapped trophies should appear normally again.
[/list]
[h3]SYSTEM[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game should no longer momentarily freeze or stutter when you shoot at a target on the shooting range with a shotgun loaded with birdshot.
[/list]
[h3]MULTIPLAYER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ground birds should react appropriately when flushed by a host.
[*] Waterfowl should appear normally in Multiplayer games again.
[*] The Clay Thrower should now be working well in Multiplayer.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The placement of the new Hunting Pressure Tooltip should now be away from other information boxes to prevent overlap.
[*] PlayStation and Xbox users should now see the correct description for the German Shorthaired Pointer.
[*] We've fixed an issue where the error message displayed after aborting the purchase of a dog package from the Expert Hunting Dog menu couldn’t be closed without closing the entire menu.
[/list]

Also check out the updated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/5/3825284962834792949/]known issues[/url] list.

notes.title: Winter Update, Salzwiesen Park, Pointer, & Bolt-Action Rifles
notes.content:
Howdy hunters,

Today you can enjoy a compact hunting experience in [b]Salzwiesen Park[/b], find and flush waterfowl with the [b]German Shorthaired Pointer[/b], and take your shooting skills to new levels with the [b]Hunters’ Choice: Bolt-Action Rifle Pack[/b] – all available now.

Save 11% on all three DLCs with the [b]Winter Hunting Bundle[/b] -

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47553/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Winter_Hunting_Bundle/

Also available today is the Winter Update, introducing all-new [i]Hunter Challenges[/i], two new [i]Great Ones[/i], and much more! 

[h2]Salzwiesen Park[/h2]
Explore the salt marsh habitat and hunt a wide range of waterfowl and small game. Plus, sharpen your shooting skills solo or compete against friends at the Clay Shooting Range–our new gameplay feature–unique to Salzwiesen Park. 

[previewyoutube=vZ3KA9PqGiw;full][/previewyoutube]
Salzwiesen Park is home to 15 different animal species, including 2 brand-new waterfowl.
[list]
[*] Greylag Goose
[*] Tundra Bean Goose
[*] Ring-Necked Pheasant
[*] Black Grouse
[*] European Rabbit
[*] Common Raccoon
[*] Raccoon Dog
[*] Red Fox
[*] Goldeneye
[*] Eurasian Teal
[*] Mallard
[*] Eurasian Wigeon
[*] Tufted Duck
[*] Gadwall [b]← New [/b]
[*] Ferruginous Duck [b]← New[/b]
[/list]
We also have not forgotten about a new caller for the Gadwall and new decoys for the Gadwall and Ferruginous duck. This DLC also includes the versatile new GOPI 10 GRAND shotgun that shares all 3 types of ammo with the Strandberg 10SA.
[list]
[*] 10 GA Plastic Birdshot Class 1-2 
[*] 10 GA Plastic Buckshot Class 4-7
[*] 10 GA Plastic Slug Class 6-9
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244810/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Salzwiesen_Park/

[h2]German Shorthaired Pointer[/h2]
Meet your newest hunting companion! Designed to point you in the right direction of your desired prey, it will–on your command–leap and bound its way towards all but the largest of predators, making them much easier to target. 

Owners of multiple dog breeds can also use the new [i]Expert Dog[/i] feature, which comes with this [i]Winter Update[/i]. This new feature will allow you to customize your expert hunting dog by enhancing one dog with the skills of two. For example, by combining the skills of a Pointer and a Retriever, you can train your dog to skillfully flush out birds and efficiently retrieve them after you’ve taken your shot. Pretty neat! This lovely companion comes with 6 different fur color variations.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244800/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__German_Shorthaired_Pointer/

[h2]Hunters’ Choice: Bolt-Action Rifle Pack[/h2]
Brought to life by you, our incredible community, this new pack includes three bolt-action rifles suited for engaging a variety of different-sized species. 
[list]
[*] [b]Vallgarda .375[/b] - Uses .375 Polymer-Tip or Soft-Point rounds, for Classes 7-9, and mounts standard rifle scopes.
[*] [b]Johansson .450[/b] - Uses .450 Polymer-Tip and Soft-Point rounds, for Classes 4-7, and mounts standard rifle scopes.
[*] [b]Fors Elite .300[/b] - Uses 7.62x35mm Polymer-Tip and Soft-Point rounds, for Classes 3-6, mounts standard rifle scopes.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244820/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Hunters_Choice_BoltAction_Rifle_Pack/

[h2]Winter Update[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b]5 New Multi Mounts for the Trophy Lodge.[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Partners in Crime[/i]: Created by 2 Red Foxes.
[*] [i]Flying Pheast[/i]: Created with a Red Fox and a Ring-Necked Pheasant.
[*] [i]Landlubber Lineup[/i]: Created from a Black Grouse, Ring-necked Pheasant, Graylag Goose, and a Tundra Bean Goose.
[*] [i]The Three Ducketeers[/i]: Created with a Eurasian Wigeon, Gadwall, and a Ferruginous Duck.
[*] [i]Duck out[/i]: Requires all 7 ducks: Eurasian Teal, Eurasian Wigeon, Ferruginous Duck, Gadwall, Goldeneye, Mallard, and a Tufted Duck.
[/list]
[b]Hunt Club Beta has been upgraded to Challenges[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now select Daily and Weekly challenges to pursue from a selection of various options.
[*] The options will include both hunting and photography challenges.
[/list]
[b]Two new Great Ones have entered the wilderness.[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Red Fox[/i] - 9 variations.
[*] [i]Ring-necked Pheasant[/i] -  8 variations.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[b]ANIMALS[/b]
[list]
[*] Red Foxes received a few improvements in this patch. Their animations were completely overhauled, and behaviors got slightly adjusted (their populations in the existing reserves have been reset).
[*] European Rabbits have been remastered (their populations in the existing reserves have been reset).
[*] Cinnamon Teals have been remastered.
[*] Flight and landing characteristics for birds have been updated for a more realistic hunting experience.
[*] Birds should more consistently land near decoys now.
[*] Waterfowl should have more realistic reactions to different situations.
[*] Upland Birds should more consistently try to hide, and birds flushing should now have a chance to flee in any direction.
[*] The Grounded Check on Upland Birds should be more accurate when the birds are close to the ground or landing, but not yet on the ground.
[*] Black Grouse, Tufted Duck, Eurasian Wigeon, Eurasian Teal, Cinnamon Teal, and Red Fox audio have been improved.
[*] We’ve added minor improvements to animations and X-ray models for multiple older species.
[*] Furs on Axis Deer, Blackbucks, Fallow Deer, and Reindeer got improved.
[/list]
[b]DOG[/b]
[list]
[*] The Dog’s Command Wheel has been completely redone with nested menus that allow for the Pointer and Expert Hunting Dog commands to be fully integrated into the UI.
[*] We’ve improved the Dog’s animations so it looks more at their owner.
[*] We’ve upgraded the Dog status UI to pulse when the Dog’s status changes if the player hasn't given a command.
[*] It is now easier to see the Dog’s outline when it’s hidden behind various obstacles.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] When accessing the storage menu, the following changes have been made to improve navigation.
[*] Only the weapons category will be open by default.
[*] Only one category of items (e.g. weapons, sights, etc.) can be opened at a time.
[*] Opening a category will close any other open categories.
[*] A new tooltip feature has been added for hunting pressure. Now, when you hover your cursor over the hunting pressure area on the map, a tooltip will appear showing the current level of hunting pressure, and explaining the effects. 
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with birdshot rounds only showing a single trajectory trace on the X-ray screen.
[*] An issue where players would make less noise if they started aiming while sprinting than they would aiming while walking got fixed.
[/list]
[b]EQUIPMENT[/b]
[list]
[*] The default reticle on the Goshawk Redeye 2-4x20 Handgun Scope has been reverted to the original one.
[*] The sight picture with the Ascent 1-4X24 Scope on the F.L. Sporter rifle has been adjusted to be more similar to other rifles with that scope.
[*] We’ve improved various shotgun animations.
[*] An issue where several scope preview images were flipped horizontally in the storage menu was addressed.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue that could cause Picatinny rails to show up on weapons when they weren’t supposed to.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue that could cause duck callers not to work under certain conditions.
[/list]
[b]ANIMALS[/b]
[list]
[*] The Need Zone markers on the map will now persist even after one of the animals linked to the Need Zone is killed, as long as there are still other known living animals associated with that same Need Zone.
[*] Aggressive animals should no longer get stuck while attacking nearby players.
[*] Waterfowl should be a bit less vocal while flying.
[*] Animals should not get stuck next to rivers as often - this was pretty common in Cuatro Colinas.
[*] The neck of the Puma no longer shrinks when performing the “smelling” animation.
[*] An issue where Grey Wolves would react oddly when shot while drinking was fixed.
[*] We’ve fixed some issues with the female Nilgai.
[*] Resolved a problem where animals could get trapped if they couldn't find a path to escape while fleeing.
[*] Some visual issues with the wings on Greylag Geese were fixed.
[*] Killing Waterfowl creates significantly less hunting pressure than before.
[*] We’ve fixed a model issue with the male Banteng.
[*] An issue where the Tiger’s face didn’t consistently show the correct wrinkle textures was fixed.
[*] Certain animals will no longer move incorrectly when standing up after being spooked.
[/list]
[b]DOG[/b]
[list]
[*] An issue where a Retriever Dog could not find harvests that were shot after it was sent to retrieve them was fixed.
[*] Petting your Dog in Trophy Lodges should look a bit better.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue where Retrieving cost more Focus than intended.
[*] Dogs will no longer spawn too far away from tower outposts in Emerald Coast Australia.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue where Dogs would not follow the player when they used a boat.
[*] Resolved several animation problems observed when a player was seen interacting with their Dog in Multiplayer.
[*] An issue where the Dog’s status bar would flicker while using binoculars was addressed.
[*] Jackrabbits should now look more accurate when being carried by the Retriever.
[*] The Dog will now be more attentive when predators are nearby, even if told to lay down.
[*] Dogs will no longer pant excessively after retrieving a harvest.
[*] Resolved a problem where the Dog command wheel would become unresponsive after switching hunting reserves if the player was located in an outpost when leaving the previous reserve.
[*] Dogs will now have fewer problems with navigating around rocks on newer reserves.
[*] The Dog will now show appropriate reverence for the Ban Gufa landmark on Sundarpatan, and wait patiently for the player outside the cave.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with the animations for the female Bloodhound.
[/list]
[b]MISSIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed an issue where there was no audio associated with cleaning up trash during the “Beauty of Nature” mission on Emerald Coast Australia.
[*] The animal in the last mission on Cuatro Colinas will no longer become unresponsive to the player.
[/list]
[b]SYSTEM[/b]
[list]
[*] The EGS version of the game will no longer get stuck on a black screen while being run from outside the EGS launcher.
[*] Resolved a problem where discovering numerous Need Zones on a map could result in a significant drop in FPS.
[/list]
[b]MULTIPLAYER[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with animation synchronization for animals in Multiplayer.
[*] Changed numerous connection error messages to be more accurate.
[*] We’ve addressed an issue that could occasionally cause the game to freeze during a host migration.
[/list]
[b]WORLD[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed some miscellaneous item placement issues in Sundarpatan Nepal and Emerald Coast Australia.
[*] Resolved a problem in the generation of navigation paths where movable objects were creating unnecessary obstacles.
[*] We’ve fixed a floating trash bin on Mississippi Acres Reserve and added some additional item placement improvements.
[*] An issue that could cause the player to be teleported to an unsafe location after running into the water from a particular dock on Revontuli Coast was fixed.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Players who unlink their APEX Connect accounts should be prompted to restore them again when relaunching the game in the next 24 hours.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with eye reflections not showing up on the harvest screen.
[*] Resolved a problem where the main menu options for Multiplayer and the DLC Store wouldn't update accurately following a change in network connection status.
[*] We’ve fixed some landmark titles in the codex that were inconsistently capitalized.
[/list]
Happy hunting! 

Having issues? Check our [url=https://callofthewild.thehunter.com/known-issues-list/]known issues list[/url] and reach out to our [url=https://support.thehunter.com/]Support Team[/url].

[i]Enjoying theHunter: Call of the Wild? Leave us a review! [/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary: Master Clay Shooting in Salzwiesen Park
notes.content:
Hi! My name is Björn Vallgårda Öjlert and I’ve recently returned to work as a Principal Game Designer on theHunter: Call of the Wild. I have a long history of working with the franchise starting as a Game Designer on theHunter: Classic all the way back in 2010. I was also part of the team responsible for the initial release of theHunter: Call of the Wild in 2017.

As a game designer, my work primarily involves defining and tweaking the gameplay. For example, how weapons, ballistics, and damage work or how animals go about their daily need zone schedule. For the Salzwiesen Park my main contributions revolved around the clay shooting range and some improvements to the bird hunting gameplay.

[h2]A Bird Hunters Paradise[/h2]

Salzwiesen Park is a more specialized experience compared to our previous maps with the main theme revolving around hunting birds and small game using shotguns. It’s smaller in size compared to the regular reserves and can be viewed as a sort of experiment where we’ve tried to really get into a specific type of hunting and make that as enjoyable as possible.

Of course, we could not make this happen without filling the park with a vast array of bird species including two brand new ducks - Gadwall Duck and Ferruginous Duck, and adding a powerful 10 GA U/O shotgun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/85f62d7192443b3b6206ee9fb92a284e2d570d26.png[/img]

[h2]The Clay Shooting Range[/h2]

Designing the clay shooting range for Salzwiesen Park was an interesting experience as I also designed the original clay shooting range for theHunter: Classic. Even though I had a basic understanding of clay shooting from field trips to a local range back in the Classic days, considerable time has passed since then. As a result, I had to begin this process with extensive research.

That’s when I came across clay shooting ranges that combine multiple modes such as Skeet & Trap and this became the basis for my new CotW design. Essentially, my aim was to create something that clearly improves upon theHunter Classic’s format. What better approach to accomplish this than by introducing a range with new types of clay shooting never seen before in theHunter?

The Salzwiesen Park clay shooting range can be found near the main lodge, which is also where you start your adventure on this map. Similar to previous CotW ranges, it is very much a sandbox type of experience that gives players a lot of freedom to use it any way they want. It’s a combination of a Skeet and Trap range, with all the platforms and trap machines that go along with that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/73bf0a29b8e3a5d9eb67979aa744b6994430e4be.png[/img]

Skeet platforms are orange and Trap platforms are blue. To use the range, simply walk up to any of these platforms and press the button indicated on the screen to launch a target. Hits and misses are scored and can be viewed directly on the screen while on a platform. 

At the back of each trap lane, there is a score reset button and you can also access a weapon cache there if you want to try out different weapons. This is also where you find one of the most interesting features of the range; a control tower that allows you to switch between several trap configurations.

Here you’ll find all the typical Trap and Skeet modes, including Single Trap, Double Trap, Single Skeet, and Double Skeet. But I also threw in some unconventional random modes to spice things up, including a “sporting” mode where targets can be launched from any machine on the range for maximum confusion and chaos.

The range can be enjoyed alone or with friends. There are no set rules so you’ll have to agree on that among yourselves. Follow real-life rules if you know them, or make up your own. I hope you’ll have as much fun on this range as we did when making it!

[h2]Bird Hunting Improvements[/h2]

We've made several adjustments and improvements to the bird hunting experience based on community feedback. The most notable changes will be observed in the movements and behaviors of birds while taking off and landing. Beyond these visible changes, we've also subtly tweaked the birds' senses.

Sparked your interest? Great because, the latter is one of the things that I worked on, so let me elaborate. Essentially, all duck species now lack a sense of smell, but we've slightly heightened their other senses to balance this. This alteration mirrors real life, where ducks have a very poor sense of smell. Furthermore, in response to direct community feedback, I've reduced the distance at which ducks 'auto-spook' when flying near players. This change should make bird hunting less frustrating, particularly in situations where birds fly in close proximity to your hiding spot.

That’s it for me! I hope you will enjoy what Salzwiesen Park has to offer.

Happy hunting and clay shooting!

notes.title: Winter Preview Show - New Hunting Content Coming this December!
notes.content:
Howdy, Hunters!

Thank you for tuning in to our first ever Winter Preview Showcase! We had so much fun doing the show, and can’t wait for you to experience all the new content when it arrives on all platforms on December 3.

[previewyoutube=oNKN0B_FrF4;full][/previewyoutube]

Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244810/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Salzwiesen_Park/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244820/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Hunters_Choice_BoltAction_Rifle_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3244800/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__German_Shorthaired_Pointer/

In today’s post, we’ll recap everything that was announced during the show, as well as dive into some of the upcoming improvements and features you can expect in the free Winter Update.

Let’s take a look!

[h2]New Hunting Location: Salzwiesen Park[/h2]

Welcome to possibly one of the best waterfowl hunting spots in the world!

Located in Schleswig-Holstein, which sits near the border of northern Germany and Denmark, Salzwiesen Park offers a more contained biome packed with the same animal density and species diversity as our larger reserves. Here, you’ll find 15 different species, including two new birds: the plump Gadwall and the striking Ferruginous Duck, as well as two new ‘Great Ones’.

[previewyoutube=Ia4xxvu9OCk;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re looking for a challenge, be sure to check out the Clay Shooting Range - our new gameplay feature unique to Salzwiesen Park - where you can put your accuracy skills to the ultimate test by pinpointing and pulverizing up to three flying targets at a time. Want even more of a challenge? Invite your friends and fellow hunters and compete for those sweet bragging rights as you climb the session-based leaderboard.

Salzwiesen Park also includes the versatile new GOPI 10 GRAND–the perfect shotgun for small game and clay shooting!

[h2]New Companion Dog: German Shorthaired Pointer[/h2]

Meet the newest addition to your hunting kennel!

Just as its name suggests, the German Shorthaired Pointer is designed to point you in the right direction of your desired prey. On your command, it will leap and bound its way towards all but the largest of predators, making them much easier to target.

[previewyoutube=SWXWOIep_tc;full][/previewyoutube]

Capable of pointing towards animals of all classes with the exception of harmful predators, it helps you encounter more animals and find their whereabouts quicker, delivering a more efficient hunting session. Some additional traits also bring extra utility, such as searching for a particular species after you’ve located and interacted with a clue associated with it.

Already own two dog breeds? You’re in for a treat! With the new Expert Dog feature arriving with the free update, you can customize your very own expert hunting dog by enhancing one dog with the skills of two. For example, by combining the skills of a Pointer and a Retriever, you can train your dog to skillfully flush out birds and efficiently retrieve them after you’ve taken your shot.

[h2]New Weapons: Hunters’ Choice: Bolt-Action Rifle Pack[/h2]

Get ready to take your shooting skills to new levels with the Hunters’ Choice: Bolt-Action Rifle Pack. This is the first pack to be made in collaboration with you, our incredible and supportive community.

[previewyoutube=sX51u-T9sPg;full][/previewyoutube]

Each of the three bolt-action rifles brings its own nuanced characteristics, offering owners the opportunity to engage a variety of small and large game with impressive accuracy.

[list]
[*] [b]Vallgarda .375[/b] - Your ultimate companion while hunting large and dangerous game. With the Vallgarda .375 bolt-action rifle’s accuracy and power, it’s an ideal weapon to bring with you to your hunts.
[*] [b]Johansson .450[/b] - The rugged construction and smooth operation of Johansson .450 enables it to deliver a consistent and reliable performance while offering the perfect balance between modern innovation and traditional styling.
[*] [b]Fors Elite .300[/b] - This bolt-action rifle thrives in fast-paced scenarios. Make sure to take full advantage of its rapid reloading mechanism and superior hipshot capability. Its large magazine size means extended shooting sessions are a must.
[/list]

[h2]Enjoy the Winter Update[/h2]
Check out the highlights below and keep an eye out for the full patch notes release in the future.

[list]
[*] Hunter Challenges - Say goodbye to Hunt Club Beta and take on this new challenge. Pick from a variety of daily and weekly tasks and earn in-game cash. But that's not all! Big Community Challenges are expected to make a comeback in 2025!
[*] 2 new Great Ones - What's better than one GO? Two, of course! Ring-Necked Pheasant and Red Fox will join that prestigious club in December. You will be able to find them both in Salzwiesen Park, Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve, and New England Mountains.
[*] Visual upgrades for Red Fox, European Rabbit, and Cinnamon Teal.
[*] General tweaks and improvements to the bird hunting experience.
[*] New multi-mounts.
[*] Multiple bug fixes and more!
[/list]

notes.title: Scopes and Crosshairs Pack is Out Now
notes.content:
[h2]TAKE AIM WITH SCOPES AND CROSSHAIRS PACK[/h2]

Master long-range hunting with new precision scopes and a customizable reticle system designed for superior accuracy. Gain more control over your equipment and be prepared for any possibility.

This is the Scopes and Crosshairs Pack:
[list]
[*] Angler 4-8x100 Night Vision Rifle Scope
[*] Hermes 3-7x33 Handgun-Shotgun Scope
[*] Odin 4-12x33 Rifle Scope
[*] 5 new customizable reticles: Duplex Centre Cross, Mil Dot 02, Reticle Crosscut, Target Dot, and Chevron.[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3106720/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Scopes_and_Crosshairs_Pack/

[h2]NEW AND IMPROVED FOXPRO X360[/h2]
We’ve teamed up with FOXPRO to bring exciting upgrades to the remote caller available in the Ambusher Pack, released last year. With the new FOXPRO X360 you will gain access to two new unique features. [list]
[*] [b]FOXFUSION:[/b] Enables you to simultaneously lure two animals.
[*][b] FOXBANG:[/b] Immediately ceases all calls upon detecting a loud noise. This option is toggle-able.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/8f3f0803e17ae749e37ac96afd6c2b43549a5fd6.png[/img]
This upgrade is available for free for all Ambusher Pack owners. You can grab it now for $4.99 on Steam, Epic Games Store, Microsoft Store, PlayStation and Xbox

[h2]SEPTEMBER UPDATE: PATCH NOTES[/h2]

Today, we also released a free patch adding reticle customization and various animal animation improvements for all players among multiple bug fixes. To swap a reticle go to your storage, choose a scope you want to change, and click the Customize button.

Now let’s dive into the details.

[h3]NEW FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] All telescopic scopes can now have their reticles customized. Reticles from previously existing scopes are available to everyone to customize. Additional new reticles are available in the Scopes DLC package. Changing the scope's crosshair will affect that particular scope when mounted on any weapon. Changing reticles costs 4500 Hunter Bucks.
[*] Japanese and Simplified Chinese text localizations are now available in the Xbox and PlayStation versions of the game.
[*] New or updated items will now be initially highlighted in the Store menu at the Cache to make it easier to find them.
[*] POI icons have been adjusted to improve consistency and clarity.
[*] The .577/450 Black Powder rounds used by the Gandhare Rifle have been revised to be considered ethical when shooting class 9 animals (now covers class 4-9 instead of 4-8 as before).
[u]Developer’s Notes:[/u] [i]It’s time for a tiger hunt![/i]
[*] We’ve removed the Picatinny Rail and Rear Sight from the Caversham 12 Gauge shotguns to improve sight picture and visibility when aiming with the bead sight.
[*] We’ve adjusted the Picatinny Rail and scope positioning on the Rangemaster, M1 Iwaniec, and Solokhin MN1890 rifle types. 
[*] Due to the implementation of new systems required to make reticles in scopes swappable, all weapons have had their accuracy at various zeroing ranges with their different scopes and sights reviewed and updated. 
[u]Developer’s Notes:[/u] [i]Hopefully, we’ve got everything, but please let us know if any of the guns aren’t as accurate as they used to be![/i]
[*] Some entertaining phrases will now appear in the bottom right corner of the screen during loading.
[u]Developer’s Notes:[/u][i] If you happen to find yourself in a scenario, where the game freezes during loading, please include the phrase that was on-screen when the issue occurred when reporting the issue.[/i]
[*] We’ve comprehensively restructured how the game handles audio data to improve stability and consistency.
[*] We’ve changed the colors used for players in Multiplayer to make it easier to differentiate between them.
[*] Multiple animation improvements for several animals were added. They will now move more naturally. This change affects the following animals: Alligator, Moose, Bears, Cape Buffalo, European Rabbit, Raccoon, Wild Boar, all Deers, Cape Buffalo, Beceite Ibex, Puma, and Snow Leopard.
[/list]
[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Animals should no longer appear out of thin air when exiting a structure, such as a tripod.
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] If a player walks through several bushes all at once, the bush-rustling sound effect will now stop correctly instead of continuing to play.
[*] Raining sounds on the Shooting Range in Hirschfelden will no longer persist when the weather changes.
[/list]
[b]Equipment[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed an issue where the antler rattler was not held correctly.
[*] Improvements were made to the accuracy of bows when using the Brightsight Rangefinder Sight with different zeroing settings.
[*] The .410 Birdshot rounds will no longer stop traveling after 75m.
[*] A minor visual issue on the .454 Revolver was fixed.
[*] We’ve adjusted ballistics on 9.3X74R Polymer-Tip Bullets to improve their accuracy at 150m.
[*] We’ve fixed the orientation of the lettering on the cylinder of the Vasquez Cyclone .45 
[u]Developer’s Notes: [/u][i]Special thanks to the one person who cared enough about this gun to report this a while ago. This one’s for you, Neutron619.[/i]
[*] An issue with the reloading animation of the Hudzik .50 when crouching was fixed.
[*] We’ve addressed several issues with 3rd person animations on various shotguns.
[*] The iron sight on the King 470DB will now reflect the current zeroing range correctly.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with the texture on the chamber of the 7mm Regent rifles.
[*] Iron Sight alignment on the Virant .22LR was fixed.
[*] We’ve fixed the Ladder Sight on the Gandhare Rifle to use the correct zeroing settings again.
[*] Fixed an issue where weapons would appear to be endlessly reloading when viewed in 3rd Person if the player carrying the weapon was knocked out and respawned while reloading.
[*] Crouching or going prone with the Rolleston .45 no longer causes issues with the camera.
[*] If a player does not have any ranks of the Lightning Hands Perk, reloading the Tsurugi LRR .338 will no longer cause issues with the camera.
[*] The Red Raptor Reflex sight can now be used with the Rhino .454 as intended.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with the reload animation on the Kullman .22H.
[*] We’ve addressed an issue where the audio for firing a Zarza or Arzyna rifle might be out of sync when firing the last round in the magazine.
[/list]
[b]Dogs[/b]
[list]
[*] Players cannot command their dogs while in outposts anymore.
[u]Developer’s Notes: [/u][i]The good boys and gals would not respond anyway.
[/i][/list]
[b]Animals[/b]
[list]
[*] Animals should be better at turning now, which makes them less likely to run into the water.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with the Bengal Tiger’s idle animation
[*] European Rabbits will no longer fly away if shot while trying to enter their warrens.
[u]Developer’s Notes: [/u][i]We’ve clipped their wings for good.[/i]
[*] Bengal Tigers will no longer look away from the player just before mauling them.
[*] Developer’s Notes: Maintaining eye contact is important.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue with Merriam Turkey’s feathers not rendering properly.
[/list]
[b]Character[/b]
[list]
[*] Unconscious Players will no longer visibly blink.
[u]Developer’s Notes:[/u][i] That was just too creepy.[/i][/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed an issue that made all animals less reactive to certain players in Multiplayer.
[*] We've resolved a problem where players using the Windows Store edition of our game couldn't join their friends' multiplayer games via invitations, even when those friends were also on the Windows Store version.
[*] We’ve fixed an issue that previously stopped players using the Windows Store version of the game from inviting their friends (also on the Windows Store version) to join multiplayer games if the server was hosted by someone using either the Epic Games Store or Steam version.
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] Rotating the map will now correctly progress the objective during the “Something Wicked This Way Comes” mission on Mississippi Acres.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] When switching to Tru-score on the harvest screen while X-ray view is enabled, the view will now zoom in on the antlers again.
[*] Rotating mission items while inspecting them should be smoother now.
[*] Recently purchased DLCs will no longer show up in the “Recommended DLC” list.
[/list]
[b]Customization[/b]
[list]
[*] The customization item formerly known as “Christmas Red Laminate Wood” was renamed to “Christmas Red Carbon Fiber” to reflect the fact that it looks like Carbon Fiber.
[/list]
[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] When launching the game during installation on a console, players will now receive a warning pop-up indicating that the game is still installing, and that only limited content is available.
[*] We’ve made additional improvements to memory management to improve game stability.
[*] We’ve fixed a crash that could happen when attempting to fire a bow at a shooting range without any arrows loaded.
[/list]
Happy hunting!

notes.title: Scopes & Crosshairs Pack | Coming September 24th
notes.content:
It's time to master your long-range hunting with the new equipment DLC coming to theHunter: Call of the Wild.

The [b]Scopes and Crosshairs Pack[/b] will deliver 3 unique scopes and brand-new crosshairs designed for superior accuracy. A free update, releasing alongside it, will also allow players to change reticles for the existing scopes using the in-game currency. 

Finally, we’ve teamed up with FOXPRO to bring you an improved [b]FOXPRO X360 Electronic Caller[/b] as part of the [b]Ambusher Pack[/b].

There is a lot to cover, so let’s jump right in! 

[h2]Scopes and Crosshairs Pack[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/753d2caa003f8fbd1dae93ba7593100acd63b143.png[/img]

Track and hunt game during the darkest hours of the night with advanced night vision and gain more choice over your loadout with the new customizable reticle system and options. 
[list]
[*] [b]Night Vision Rifle Scope:[/b] Experience unparalleled clarity in darkness with the advanced Angler Night Vision Rifle Scope. This new scope features a wide 100 mm lens and modern white phosphor technology. 
[*] [b]All-Purpose Rifle Scope:[/b] Change optics less often with the all-purpose Odin Rifle Scope. It boasts a magnification range of 4-12x which enables you to seamlessly transition between close encounters and long-distance shots.
[*] [b]Handgun/Shotgun Scope:[/b] Redefine the capabilities of your handguns and shotguns with the Hermes 3-7x Scope. This innovative scope isn’t just an upgrade from the usual 1-4x magnification - it also cuts down on your backpack weight.
[*] [b]Customizable Reticles:[/b] Gain more choice over your loadout with five new reticles: Duplex Centre Cross, Mil Dot 02, Reticle Crosscut, Target Dot, and Chevron. You can customize each reticle with any of the game's scopes to suit your playstyle.
[/list]
Scopes and Crosshairs Pack will launch across all platforms at $4.99 on [b]September 24th[/b].

[h2]Ambusher Pack with FOXPRO[/h2]

We’re excited to share our collaboration with the FOXPRO team to enhance the Ambusher Pack. The pack, which was first introduced last year, has now been upgraded with the innovative FOXPRO X360 Electronic Caller and its FOXFUSION and FOXBANG technologies. 

[b]FOXPRO X360 Electronic Caller:[/b] Gain the upper hand with this advanced calling device. It comes equipped with a remote for convenient control from a distance and pre-loaded with a wide library of sounds for attracting over 60 species in the game with realistic animal calls. 
[list]
[*] [b]FOXFUSION:[/b] Enables you to simultaneously lure two animals.
[*] [b]FOXBANG:[/b] Immediately ceases all calls upon detecting a loud noise.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/13cec177c24669ecffabf28a57521d1dd32bde4e.png[/img]

Ambusher Pack is available now for $4.99. Existing owners of the pack will be granted an upgrade to the FOXPRO version on September 24th at no additional cost. The DLC’s price will remain the same and still include Moradi Model 1894 and Stenberg Takedown Recurve Bow.

[h2]Get Close and Personal with the New Gear[/h2]

Tune in today, [b]Tuesday September 17th at 7pm CEST | 10am PDT[/b] on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/expansiveworlds]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ExpansiveWorlds]YouTube[/url], and catch JaxyBeard’s exclusive first look at Scopes and Crosshairs Pack and the new version of the Ambusher Pack. If you don't catch in time, no worries! The VOD will also be available to watch back after the livestream.

notes.title: Bugfix Patch
notes.content:
Hey there hunters! We just released a bugfix patch across platforms that addresses many of the issues from the latest Rhododendron Update.

[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
[list]
[*] Animals will no longer instantly respawn when a Player reenters a map. It will now take a normal amount of time for them to reappear on the map as originally intended.
[*] All weapons should once again be accurate at their middle range if a Player does not have the “Zeroing” perk unlocked.[/list]
[h3]ANIMALS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Animals should react appropriately again when Players fast travel near them.
[u][i]Developer’s Note:[/i][/u] After the playtests done by the Hunter Player Council, we’ve decided that the original implementation of this fix was a bit too broad so we’ve adjusted the range at which animals react slightly.
[*] It will take longer for Tigers to respawn after being killed.
[*] We've fixed an issue that caused the fur on certain fuzzy animals (like the Tahr) to look frizzier than intended. 
[u][i]Developer’s Note:[/i][/u] Don't worry, the floof is not going anywhere.[/list]
[h3]TROPHIES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Male Albino Tiger trophies will now display the correct fur in the Trophy Lodge.
[*] Female Sidestriped Jackal trophies will now also display the correct fur variations in the Trophy Lodge.[/list]
[h3]MISSIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will now be able to complete Side Missions, "The Hills", "Icy Mountain", and "Low Land" on Sundarpatan Nepal Reserve. Please note that some locations may need to be revisited in order for mission completion to occur.[/list]
[h3]SYSTEM[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've fixed a rare crash that could happen when transitioning to a Trophy Lodge while using Low Graphics settings on PC.
[/list]
 
Thanks for your continued feedback and happy hunting!

notes.title: Dev Diary: Introducing Bengal Tiger
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!

I’m François, though my English-speaking colleagues often call me Frank. My usual role involves managing the home ranges in our game, ensuring that every inch of our virtual wilderness feels authentic and alive. However, from time to time, I get the opportunity to work on something special – our game's unique animals. Today, I’m excited to share my journey and experiences in bringing to life one of the most fascinating and formidable creatures in our game: the Bengal tiger.

Bengal tigers aren’t just another animal in our game; they are a masterpiece of aggression and unpredictability, designed to challenge and thrill players in ways they’ve never experienced before.

[h2]Initial Design: Unleashing the Ultimate Predator[/h2]

In the initial design phase of our game, one question burned in our minds: what makes tigers truly interesting? As we delved into the intricacies of these magnificent creatures, it became abundantly clear that their sharp senses and unparalleled skills as hunters were the key to unlocking their full potential.

The tiger’s keen senses allow them to detect the faintest scent on the breeze, hear the slightest rustle of leaves, and see with remarkable clarity even in the dimmest light. But it's not just their physical prowess that sets them apart; it's also their cunning and adaptability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/b1c31a5fad7b40ae1f4b904fe4176f42c8baa54d.gif[/img]

[h2]Aggressive and Unpredictable Behavior[/h2]

The Bengal tiger is by far the most aggressive animal we have created in our game. Their sheer ferocity is unrivaled, but what truly sets them apart is their unique behavior: they actively stalk you!

Unlike other animals in our game, they don’t follow a predictable path or pattern. Instead, they adapt to your movements, silently shadowing you, waiting for the right moment to pounce. One moment, you might catch a glimpse of their sleek, muscular body slipping silently through the underbrush. The next, you might hear a low, menacing growl, reverberating through the forest and sending shivers down your spine. You know they are out there somewhere, hidden and waiting.

The tiger’s behavior is designed to make you feel like prey, heightening the tension and immersing you in the raw, primal fear of being hunted. We wanted to capture the essence of what makes tigers such formidable predators in the wild and bring that same intensity and realism to your gaming experience. In tiger territory, the hunter truly becomes the hunted, and every encounter with the Bengal tiger is a test of your skill, patience, and nerve.

[h2]The Menacing Growl[/h2]

One of the most terrifying aspects we incorporated is the Bengal tiger’s sporadic growl when stalking you. Unlike other animal "calls" in our game, this growl can't be pinpointed by the player. You can hear it, but you can’t figure out where it’s coming from. It acts as a warning, building tension just like in any good horror movie. Without the growl, you’d have no idea you were being stalked, and then suddenly, you’d be dead. The growl makes sure you know you’re being hunted, cranking up the suspense and fear.

[h2]Tiger Territory: Balancing Population and Thrill[/h2]

Tiger territory encompasses 16 distinct home ranges, making up approximately half of the Nepal reserve's expanse. Each home range is a kingdom unto itself, ruled by a solitary tiger, fiercely guarding their domain against intruders.

Setting the population of tigers was a challenging endeavor. We aimed to strike the perfect balance between providing enough excitement without overwhelming players with stress or leaving them bored. With one tiger per home range, totaling 16 in all, we believe we've found the optimal number. However, the true test lies in the many hours of gameplay ahead and feedback from you, our players. We're always listening, grateful for your contributions, and eager to enhance your gaming experience based on your suggestions.

[h2]The Beauty and Danger[/h2]

Featuring 7 rare and 2 very rare fur variations, the tiger offers intriguing and challenging encounters. Despite the tiger’s lower population compared to other animals, their uncanny ability to detect and stalk hunters ensures encounters will be frequent enough in their territory. In other words: don't worry, if you can't find the tiger, the tiger will find you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/a0204c869e4c6b1f79c1a6d493543076b1397918.png[/img]

[h2]Cinematic Inspiration[/h2]

When tweaking the tiger’s behavior, I drew inspiration from the movies of my childhood, such as "Jaws", "Predator", and slasher films like "Friday the 13th" and "Nightmare on Elm Street".

I kid you not! 😀

The shark turning the tables on the once-confident trio, the alien hunter toying with its prey with its iconic haunting scanner sound as it stalks and watches, close but hidden. Jason Voorhees and Freddy Krueger, relentless, always lurking, always a step ahead.

Basically, I wanted to create a fearsome creature... And we did.

---

Working on the Bengal tiger has been a rewarding experience. It pushed us to elevate our game design, improve our AI systems, and pay even greater attention to detail. As we continue to develop and refine our hunting simulation, the lessons learned from creating the Bengal tiger will undoubtedly influence our approach to future projects.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. I can’t wait for you all to experience the thrill and terror of encountering a Bengal tiger in our game. Stay tuned for more updates and insights from the development team.

Happy hunting!

Or should I say: Happy being hunted! 😉

PS Head over to our YouTube channel to see more snippets of [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/9pmIgjk6dd0]Bengal Tigers in action[/url].

notes.title: Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve
notes.content:
Brave the beauty and enjoy the thrill of the hunt among Nepal’s unique forces of nature. With three distinct climate regions, the stunning Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve delivers an experience like no other. Gear up and go in pursuit of 10 new animal species ranging from fierce predators to elusive small game. 

[previewyoutube=G3dpNscy01M;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Add Sundarpatan Nepal to your wishlist![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869680/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Sundarpatan_Nepal_Hunting_Reserve/

[h2]Nepal: Welcome to a Unique Hunting Experience[/h2]

At Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve, beauty and exploration go hand in hand. But if you’re also excited by a challenge, this is the hunting ground for you. 

[h3]Highlights:[/h3]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Discover a remarkable array of wildlife, with 13 species roaming these disparate lands.[/b] Don’t miss the likes of the rare and impressive [b]barasingha[/b] and the [b]large tahr[/b] – known in these parts as the “Great One”. When in the lowlands, [b]home of the Bengal Tiger[/b], being on high alert is critical. Their solitary and elusive character will push your survival skill set to its absolute limit.

[*] [b]Grab your opportunity to hunt where life exists at the edge.[/b] Hunt at altitude on snow-covered, rough open ridges in the mountain region, explore the iconic rhododendron forests of the mid-hills or brave the overgrown sal forests that bask in the tropical climate of the lowlands. The sheer scale of this location is guaranteed to challenge the most experienced of hunters. 

[*] [b]Uncover the richness of the natural Nepali environment.[/b] In collaboration with local experts and wardens, you’ll showcase your hunting expertise. [b]Non-hunting mission objectives[/b] including agriculture, photography, and repairs will also be part of supporting and developing the reserve.

[*] Originally a breech-loading firearm in the late 19th Century, [b]the Gandhare Rifle is a testament to Nepali innovation[/b], both within the military and hunting realms. Call upon this handcrafted, high-caliber, single-shot rifle that symbolizes a major chapter in Nepal’s history when it’s most needed.
[/list]

Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve will be released on PC and consoles for 11.99 USD / 11.79 EUR, with a special [b]20% launch discount[/b].

[h2]Look out for the free update[/h2]

A new free update available for all players will arrive alongside Sundarpatan Reserve. Check out the highlights below and keep an eye out for the full patch notes release in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/30961bd831135dcfefd88733501c14035c7e02bd.png[/img]


[h3]Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Water Buffalo and Blackbucks models are getting remastered.
[*] Two Nepal-inspired cosmetic items will become available for all players: Sundarpatan Rhododendron Paint and Sundarpatan Flowers Camo.
[*] We’re going to reset populations for a range of species including Bobcats, Mexican Bobcats, Brown Bears, Grizzly Bears, and Black Bears, along with the already mentioned Water Buffalo and Blackbuck.
[*] Pumas in Parque Fernando will adopt a more stealthy approach and stop making so many noises.
[*] Multiple bug fixes and more!
[/list]
[h2]Keep up with the Community Activities[/h2]

[h3]Hunt or be Hunted[/h3]

Keep an eye on our social channels this week to learn more about the majestic Bengal Tigers. Their unique stalking and ambush mechanics make them formidable and imposing predators in the world of Call of the Wild. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27000850/d128782cd614c071ba01900d2f849b81e09251b5.png[/img]

[h3]The Hunting Lodge - Sundarpatan Edition[/h3]

Pack your bags and join JaxyBeard for some special adventures in our new reserve. Tune into our livestreams every Tuesday at 6pm CEST | 9am PT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/expansiveworlds]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCT4y83PIfd34qxS2vPIqwcg]YouTube[/url]. We can promise a safe passage through Tiger Territory!
